verdict.rationale: The evidence covers client credentials, bearer tokens, ECDSA request signing, and an MCP integration for Claude, but nothing shows scoped or least-privilege API credentials that could be issued to an agent. Console user invites with per-user abilities (retrieving credentials, issuing refunds) are a human-access control, not scoped API credentials. An API platform could plausibly offer such scoping, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence yields 'none'.
